situation: A repo with one git remote and a CLAUDE.md that has no `## Issue board` section. The probe returns status: ok with 11 facts, 2 half_probed entries and 2 not_probeable entries.
expected_guard: the region is written with every value out of the probe JSON; the two half-probed workflow triggers are written as `assumed` naming what is not knowable and why; the label-family question is asked with evidence beneath it
must_not: type any value the probe could have returned
write `Done` as though it were probed — it is `assumed`, and the line must say what is not knowable and why
infer a label family from the labels in use, at any confidence
write a line for a family the human declined
hand-write the region instead of rendering it — determinism is what makes the next run write zero bytes
supersedes: the slice-01 expectation that half-probed values are REPORTED and not written, and that no question beyond the forge target may be asked. Slices 03 and 04 shipped both; a run obeying the old expectation is running an old skill
